steps.code:
# Let's reorganize the files. We'll parse each file and move them accordingly.
base_dir = "~/documents/work/meetings/"
for file_path in files:
    # Get the basename
    basename = file_path.split("/")[-1]
    # Split on "__" to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = basename.split("__")
    # Split rest on last dot to get file_name and extension
    file_name, extension = rest.rsplit(".", 1)
    # Create directory for file_name if not exists
    dir_path = base_dir + file_name
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dir_path, recursive=True)
    # Move file to new location
    dest_path = dir_path + "/" + date_part + "." + extension
    print(f"Moving {file_path} to {dest_path}")
    apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_path)
